verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device and cloud inference SDK/CLI. The evidence documents only developer building blocks: LLM generation, structured output, tool calling, and VLM. A developer could use these to build an insights feature, but the product does not ship one itself. No citation shows any in-product feature that analyzes the user's own data (e.g., usage or account data) to surface AI-generated insights or suggestions.
